title: MARS COLONY: Life Support Failed
You Have two hours to live 🚀🔴
Oxygen Lost on Mars

script.beat: 1 HOOK: impossible stakes stated as fact, no setup
script.text: What if your Mars habitat just lost oxygen? You only have two hours to survive.

script.beat: 2 SETUP: the world, the numbers, the everyman
script.text: Ares Prime. Twelve people on board. CO2 scrubber failed. Backup's frozen. Help is eight months out.

script.beat: 3 ESCALATION: three paths, each harder, dialogue beats
script.text: Commander Voss grabs rover keys. Eight klicks to Backup Hab. Dr. Chen seals the greenhouse. Algae makes oxygen. Engineer Kovic checks his leaking suit. Surface cache is two klicks out.

script.beat: 4 MYSTERY BEAT: the question that changes everything
script.text: Wait. The comms dish — boost the signal, Earth hears us today. Resupply launches in six weeks.

script.beat: 5 THE CATCH: flips it on the viewer, the real constraint
script.text: Here's the catch. Power for ONE. Rover motors. Greenhouse seals. Suit heaters. Comms array. Pick wrong, everyone dies in the dark.

script.beat: 6 CHOICE CARD + LOOP: A-D options, vote in comments
script.text: A: Rover dash — eight klicks, red dust, Earth rising. B: Greenhouse gamble — seal the dome, watch algae glow. C: Surface walk — two klicks, suit hissing, stars forever. D: Signal Earth — dish aimed home, blue dot, weeks of hope. Vote in comments. Next part opens with the oxygen winner.

science.claim: Mars habitats would rely on CO2 scrubbers for breathable air.
science.working: Real NASA life support uses molecular sieves (zeolite) to capture CO2; failure scenarios are studied in analogs like HI-SEAS.
science.source: NASA Life Support Systems Technical Documents; HI-SEAS mission reports

science.claim: Algae bioreactors can generate oxygen in closed habitats.
science.working: Spirulina and chlorella systems are tested for ISS and Mars transit; they produce O2 but require light, power, and time to scale.
science.source: ESA MELiSSA project; NASA OMEGA project

science.claim: Mars-Earth communication delay is 4-24 minutes depending on orbit.
science.working: At opposition ~4 min, at conjunction ~24 min. No real-time conversation possible.

science.claim: Resupply from Earth to Mars takes 6-9 months with current tech.
science.working: Hohmann transfer windows every 26 months; fastest transit ~6 months with chemical propulsion.
